name: Brand Identity
outcome: A brand that looks and sounds like it belongs at the top of its category.
description: Logo, color, type, voice — designed as one coherent system, not a scattered set of assets. We build brand identities that hold up across a pitch deck, a product UI and a billboard.
forWho: Founders launching a new venture or rebranding one that has outgrown its first identity.
problem: Your brand is a pile of mismatched assets. The logo came from one place, the deck from another, the website from a third, and none of them look like the same company. Every time you need something new, you're guessing at the color, the font, the tone, and it shows.

approach.title: Strategy first
approach.text: We start with who you are and where you're headed, so the identity is built on a clear point of view instead of taste alone. No design happens until we agree on what the brand needs to say.

approach.title: Build the system
approach.text: We design the logo, color, type and voice as one connected system, then pressure-test it across a pitch deck, a product screen and a big print format. If it breaks anywhere, we fix it before handoff.

approach.title: Package and hand off
approach.text: You get a guidelines document, ready-to-use templates and a full asset library. Everything is organized so your team or your next agency can run with it on day one.

faqs.q: Do I actually own the final files and can I edit them myself?
faqs.a: Yes. You own everything, including editable source files. There's no license, no lock-in, and no need to come back to us to change a color or add a slide.

faqs.q: We already have a logo we like. Can you build around it?
faqs.a: Yes. If the mark still works, we keep it and build the rest of the system, voice and templates around it. If it's holding you back, we'll tell you honestly and show you why.

faqs.q: How is this different from hiring a freelancer on a marketplace?
faqs.a: A freelancer usually delivers a logo and disappears. We design the full system, document how to use it, and hand off a complete library, so the brand stays consistent long after we're done. Pricing is fixed and agreed up front.

metaDescription: New Machine builds brand identity as one coherent system of logo, color, type and voice that holds up everywhere your company shows up.

name: Positioning & Naming
outcome: A name and a story that make the choice obvious before the pitch starts.
description: Before a single asset gets designed, we answer the harder question: what do you stand for, and why should anyone pick you over the next tab open in their browser. Naming, positioning and messaging built to survive a competitive market.
forWho: Early-stage founders and teams entering a crowded market who need a sharper story.
problem: You know your product is good, but explaining why it's different takes five minutes and a whiteboard. Prospects compare you to the other tab open in their browser and can't tell you apart. The name, the pitch and the messaging all shift depending on who's talking.

approach.title: Map the field
approach.text: We study your category, your competitors and the language they use, so we can find the space that's actually open. You can't stand out until you know what everyone else already sounds like.

approach.title: Sharpen the story
approach.text: We build your positioning, core messaging and audience definition into one clear argument for why someone should pick you. Every claim is written to survive a skeptical buyer, not just a friendly one.

approach.title: Name and pitch
approach.text: We develop naming and a tagline that fit the positioning, then package it into an elevator pitch and one-pager your whole team can repeat. Everyone ends up telling the same story.

faqs.q: How does naming work if the domain or trademark is already taken?
faqs.a: We factor availability into the process and steer toward names with a realistic path to a domain and a mark. We're not lawyers, so we'll flag when it's time to get a trademark search, but we won't hand you a name that's obviously blocked.

faqs.q: What do you need from us to get started?
faqs.a: Time with the people who know the business and the customer, plus any research or sales calls you can share. The sharper your input on who you're for, the sharper the positioning comes out.

faqs.q: Can you do positioning without a full rename?
faqs.a: Yes. Naming and positioning are often bought together, but plenty of teams keep their name and just need a clearer story. We scope to what you actually need and price it up front.

metaDescription: New Machine delivers positioning and naming that make the choice obvious, so buyers pick you before the pitch even starts.

name: Market Research
outcome: Decisions backed by evidence, not gut feel and internal opinion.
description: We validate demand, map the competitive landscape and talk to real customers before you commit budget to a direction. Research built to de-risk the next twelve months, not fill a slide deck.
forWho: Founders and product teams about to invest in a new market, product or audience.
problem: You're about to bet real budget and months of work on a direction, and the case for it is mostly internal opinion and a gut feeling. Nobody in the room has actually talked to the customer you're counting on. If the assumption is wrong, you won't find out until the money's already spent.

approach.title: Frame the questions
approach.text: We start by naming the decisions this research needs to inform and the assumptions you're betting on. That keeps the work focused on what changes your mind, not on filling slides.

approach.title: Gather the evidence
approach.text: We size the market, audit competitors and pricing, and talk to real customers through interviews, surveys and demand tests. You hear what buyers actually say, not what you hoped they'd say.

approach.title: Turn it into a call
approach.text: We hand back a clear findings report with a recommendation you can act on, not a data dump. It tells you what we learned, what it means, and what we'd do next.

faqs.q: What if the research says our idea won't work?
faqs.a: Then we tell you, plainly, and show you the evidence. Finding that out now is the whole point, and it's a lot cheaper than finding out after launch.

faqs.q: How many customers do you actually talk to?
faqs.a: Enough to see clear patterns, scoped to your market and question. We won't promise a fixed headcount up front, because the right number depends on how varied your audience is and how quickly the signal becomes consistent.

faqs.q: How is this different from a report I could buy off the shelf?
faqs.a: A market report tells you about the market in general. We answer your specific decision, including primary interviews with the customers you're targeting, and hand back findings tied to what you should do next. You own the full report and the raw inputs.

metaDescription: New Machine runs market research that validates demand and maps competitors, so you can commit budget on evidence instead of gut feel.

name: Website Design
outcome: Websites that turn visitors into inquiries.
description: A custom-designed website built around one job: convincing your visitors to get in touch. Fast, mobile-first and designed to look like the business you want to be — not a template everyone has seen before.
forWho: Businesses whose current site looks dated, loads slowly, or simply doesn't bring in customers.
problem: Your website looks like it was built five years ago, and you can feel prospects judging it. It loads slowly, it's hard to use on a phone, and the people who do land on it leave without ever getting in touch. You know it's costing you business, but you're not sure where to start.

approach.title: Understand the goal
approach.text: We start by getting clear on who you're trying to reach and what a good visitor action looks like. Every design decision after that serves getting more of those inquiries.

approach.title: Design and build
approach.text: We custom-design each page around your content and build it mobile-first, so it looks sharp and loads fast on every device. No templates, no layouts you've seen a hundred times before.

approach.title: Launch and hand over
approach.text: We set up analytics, wire up your contact and inquiry flows, and get the site live. You own the code and accounts outright, so nothing is locked to us.

faqs.q: How is this different from buying a template?
faqs.a: A template forces your business into someone else's layout, and your visitors have seen it before. We design around your actual content and the inquiries you want, so the site fits your business instead of the other way around.

faqs.q: How long does a website take?
faqs.a: Most sites are done in weeks, not months. The exact timeline depends on how many pages you need and how ready your content is, and we agree on it upfront with fixed pricing.

faqs.q: Do I own the site when it's finished?
faqs.a: Yes. You own the code, the content, and all the accounts. Nothing is tied to us, so you can host it, update it, or move it whenever you want.

metaDescription: Custom website design from New Machine: fast, mobile-first sites built to turn visitors into real inquiries, not templates everyone has seen.

name: Landing Pages
outcome: Focused pages built to convert one visitor into one action.
description: One page, one goal. Whether it's bookings, sign-ups or sales, we design landing pages that remove distractions and guide every visitor toward a single clear action.
forWho: Anyone running ads or campaigns who needs clicks to actually become customers.
problem: You're paying for clicks, but the traffic hits your page and bounces. Your homepage has too much going on, so visitors get distracted and never take the one action you actually paid to get. Every wasted click is money gone.

approach.title: Define the action
approach.text: We pin down the single action the page exists to drive, whether that's a booking, a sign-up, or a sale. Everything else gets stripped out.

approach.title: Design to convert
approach.text: We build a focused layout with a persuasive copy structure and fast load times, so nothing distracts from that one action. Sections are built ready for A/B testing so you can keep improving.

approach.title: Wire up tracking
approach.text: We connect form capture, routing, and campaign tracking so every lead lands where it should and you can see what your ad spend is doing. Then we launch.

faqs.q: How is a landing page different from a regular web page?
faqs.a: A landing page has one job and removes everything that doesn't serve it. There's no navigation to wander off into and no competing messages, just a clear path to a single action.

faqs.q: Can I run A/B tests on it later?
faqs.a: Yes. We build the sections to be test-ready so you can swap headlines, copy, or layouts and measure what converts better without rebuilding the page.

faqs.q: What do you need from me to start?
faqs.a: The offer you're promoting, where the traffic is coming from, and the one action you want visitors to take. We handle the copy structure, design, and tracking from there.

metaDescription: New Machine builds focused landing pages that remove distractions and turn ad and campaign clicks into one clear action, from booking to sale.

name: Corporate Websites
outcome: A credible home for your company that wins trust before the first call.
description: For established companies, your website is your handshake. We build corporate sites that communicate scale, credibility and professionalism — so prospects arrive at the meeting already convinced.
forWho: Established companies whose online presence hasn't caught up with their real-world reputation.
problem: Your company has earned a strong reputation, but your website makes you look smaller and less established than you are. Prospects check you out before a meeting and come away unsure, so you spend the first call rebuilding credibility you should already have. The gap between your real standing and your online presence is costing you trust.

approach.title: Map the structure
approach.text: We plan the full multi-page architecture around what prospects, hires, and partners need to see, from services and projects to team and news. The structure is built to scale as you grow.

approach.title: Build the design system
approach.text: We design a brand-consistent system that communicates the scale and professionalism you actually operate at. It stays coherent across every page and section.

approach.title: Set up for the long run
approach.text: We build in easy content updates, a multilingual-ready structure, and careers and news modules, then hand it over. You own everything and can keep it current without calling us.

faqs.q: Can our team update the site without a developer?
faqs.a: Yes. We build in easy content updates so your team can add news, roles, and project pages on their own. You own the accounts and content outright.

faqs.q: Can it support more than one language?
faqs.a: We build the structure to be multilingual-ready, so adding languages later doesn't mean rebuilding the site. We can scope the initial languages you need upfront.

faqs.q: How is this different from a small-business website?
faqs.a: A corporate site has to carry more weight: multiple audiences, deeper architecture, and a design system that signals scale. We build for credibility and growth, not just a few pages.

metaDescription: New Machine builds corporate websites that signal scale and credibility, so prospects arrive at the meeting already trusting your company.

name: Web App / MVP Development
outcome: A working product in your users' hands, not a deck of promises.
description: We design and build the first real version of your product — fast enough to test with actual users, solid enough to keep building on. From idea to a live, usable MVP without the six-month agency runway.
forWho: Founders who need to prove a product idea works before raising or scaling further.
problem: You have a product idea and you need to know if it actually works before you raise money or pour in more of your own. But most agencies want a six-month runway and a big budget just to get to a first version. You need something real in users' hands now, not a slide deck and an invoice.

approach.title: Scope the product
approach.text: We work out the core user flows and the smallest version that proves your idea. Anything that isn't essential to the test gets cut so we can move fast.

approach.title: Design and build
approach.text: We handle UI/UX design and full-stack development together, including the database, APIs, and the auth, billing, and integrations your product needs to actually run.

approach.title: Launch to real users
approach.text: We deploy a live, usable MVP you can put in front of actual users. It's solid enough to keep building on, and you own the code from day one.

faqs.q: How much of my product will the MVP include?
faqs.a: Just enough to prove the idea with real users. We focus on the core flows that answer your biggest question and leave the nice-to-haves for after you've learned what works.

faqs.q: Do I own the code and accounts?
faqs.a: Yes, completely. You own the code, the database, and all the accounts, so you can keep building with us, your own team, or anyone else.

faqs.q: Why not just use a no-code tool or template?
faqs.a: No-code is fine for a quick test, but it often can't handle real auth, billing, or custom logic, and you hit a wall when you scale. We build a real full-stack product you can keep growing from.

metaDescription: New Machine designs and builds web app MVPs fast: a live, usable product in your users' hands to prove the idea before you raise or scale.

name: Mobile Apps
outcome: A native-feeling app your users actually keep on their phone.
description: iOS and Android apps designed around real usage, not just a shrunk-down website. Built for speed, offline resilience and the store approval process most teams underestimate.
forWho: Businesses whose product lives on a phone, not just a browser tab.
problem: Your product really lives on a phone, but a mobile website just doesn't feel right to your users, so they don't keep coming back. Real apps also mean push notifications, offline use, and getting through App Store and Play Store review, which is harder than most teams expect. You need an app that feels native and actually makes it into the stores.

approach.title: Design for real use
approach.text: We design iOS and Android experiences around how people actually use your product on a phone, not a shrunk-down website. That means it feels native, not like a page squeezed onto a small screen.

approach.title: Build for the phone
approach.text: We handle cross-platform development with push notifications and offline support, so the app stays fast and useful even when the connection drops.

approach.title: Ship and support
approach.text: We manage App Store and Play Store submission, set up analytics and crash reporting, and support updates after launch. You own the app and the store accounts.

faqs.q: Do you build for both iOS and Android?
faqs.a: Yes. We design for both platforms and build cross-platform, so you get an app on iOS and Android without maintaining two entirely separate codebases.

faqs.q: Will you handle getting it into the app stores?
faqs.a: Yes. We manage App Store and Play Store submission, which trips up a lot of teams, and set up analytics and crash reporting so you can see how the app performs after launch.

faqs.q: Why not just make our website mobile-friendly?
faqs.a: A mobile site can't match a native app for speed, offline use, or push notifications, and it doesn't earn a spot on the home screen. We build for how people actually use their phones so users keep the app.

metaDescription: New Machine builds native-feeling iOS and Android apps with offline support, push, and store submission handled, so users keep them installed.

name: Social Media Management
outcome: Consistent, on-brand content that keeps you in front of your audience.
description: Posting consistently is hard when you're running a business. We plan, design and publish content that sounds like you, looks professional, and keeps your brand top-of-mind.
forWho: Businesses that know they should be active on social media but don't have the time or team to do it well.
problem: You know your business should show up on social every day, but the posts keep slipping because you are busy running everything else. When you do post, it feels rushed and off-brand. Weeks go quiet, and your audience forgets you exist.

approach.title: Plan in advance
approach.text: We build a monthly content calendar so nothing is posted at the last minute. You approve the plan before anything goes live.

approach.title: Sound like you
approach.text: We write captions and design posts in your actual voice, not generic filler. Your feed looks professional and stays recognizably yours.

approach.title: Publish and engage
approach.text: We schedule everything and reply to comments and messages so the account stays active. You get a monthly report on what people responded to.

faqs.q: How many posts do I get each month?
faqs.a: It depends on the plan we agree on and the platforms you want to be on. We set the volume up front so the scope and pricing are clear before we start.

faqs.q: How long before I see results?
faqs.a: Social builds slowly. Reach and engagement grow as we post consistently over months, not from a single viral post. We report the trend every month so you can see it moving.

faqs.q: Who owns the accounts and content?
faqs.a: You do. Every profile, post, and asset stays yours, and you keep full access the whole time we work together and after.

metaDescription: Social media management that keeps your brand consistent, on-brand, and in front of your audience without adding work to your plate.

name: Lead Generation
outcome: Campaigns that fill your pipeline with people ready to buy.
description: Traffic is easy — qualified leads are the hard part. We combine targeted campaigns, focused landing pages and clear offers to bring you inquiries from people who actually want what you sell.
forWho: Businesses ready to grow who want a predictable flow of inquiries, not just likes and impressions.
problem: You are getting clicks and traffic, but almost none of it turns into a real conversation. The inquiries that do come in are the wrong fit or never had money to spend. You need people ready to buy, not another spike in impressions.

approach.title: Offer first
approach.text: We start with who you want and the offer that makes them act, because targeting is worthless without a reason to respond. That strategy drives every campaign.

approach.title: Focused landing pages
approach.text: We build dedicated pages tied to each campaign so visitors do one thing: inquire. No distractions, no sending paid traffic to a busy homepage.

approach.title: Capture and route
approach.text: Leads are captured and sent straight to you or your CRM so nothing sits waiting. We optimize weekly and report transparently on cost and quality.

faqs.q: Is ad spend included in your fee?
faqs.a: No. Your ad budget is paid to the platforms and is separate from our management fee. We agree on both up front so there are no surprises.

faqs.q: How is this different from just running ads?
faqs.a: Ads bring traffic; lead generation is built end to end around turning that traffic into qualified inquiries, with the offer, landing page, and follow-up routing all handled together.

faqs.q: When will leads start coming in?
faqs.a: Campaigns can produce inquiries fairly quickly once live, but the first weeks are about testing and optimizing. We report weekly so you see cost and quality as it improves, and we keep the accounts and data in your name.

metaDescription: Lead generation that fills your pipeline with qualified inquiries from people ready to buy, not just clicks and impressions.

name: Performance Ads
outcome: Ad spend that comes back as revenue, tracked to the dollar.
description: Paid campaigns across search and social, built around a single question: does this ad make more money than it costs. We manage targeting, creative and budget so every dollar is accountable.
forWho: Businesses ready to put real budget behind growth and see exactly what it returns.
problem: You have real budget to spend but no clear picture of what it earns back. Money goes into ads and you are left guessing whether it made anything. Without accountable tracking, every dollar feels like a gamble.

approach.title: Track everything
approach.text: We set up conversion tracking and pixels first so every dollar is tied to a result. If we cannot measure it, we do not run it.

approach.title: Test the creative
approach.text: We write and design ads across search and social, then test them against each other. Budget follows whatever is actually converting.

approach.title: Optimize weekly
approach.text: We adjust targeting and spend every week toward return, not vanity metrics. You get a ROAS dashboard showing exactly what the spend returned.

faqs.q: Does your fee include the ad budget?
faqs.a: No. What you spend on the platforms is separate from our management fee. We define both clearly before launch so you know your total commitment.

faqs.q: How soon will I see a return?
faqs.a: Paid ads can move fast, but the first weeks go into testing creative and audiences to find what converts. Returns become clearer and steadier as we optimize, and we report ROAS honestly the whole way.

faqs.q: Do I keep access to the ad accounts and data?
faqs.a: Yes. The ad accounts, pixels, and performance data are yours. You own them during our work together and keep them if we ever part ways.

metaDescription: Performance ads across search and social, managed so every dollar of spend is tracked to the revenue it returns.

name: SEO
outcome: Free, compounding traffic that keeps arriving after the campaign ends.
description: Technical fixes, content strategy and link building aimed at one outcome: ranking for the searches your future customers are already typing. Slower than ads, and worth far more over time.
forWho: Businesses playing the long game who want organic traffic that doesn't stop when the budget does.
problem: You are paying for every visitor through ads, and the moment you stop paying, the traffic stops too. Meanwhile your customers are searching for what you sell and finding competitors instead. You want traffic that keeps arriving without a meter running.

approach.title: Fix the foundation
approach.text: We start with a technical audit and site speed so search engines can actually read and rank your pages. Nothing else works if the foundation is broken.

approach.title: Target real searches
approach.text: We build a keyword and content strategy around the exact terms your future customers type. Then we optimize your pages to rank for them.

approach.title: Build authority
approach.text: We earn links and strengthen your site's authority so rankings hold over time. You get a monthly rankings report to track the climb.

faqs.q: How long until SEO works?
faqs.a: Slower than ads, honestly. SEO compounds over months as pages gain authority and rankings, but that traffic keeps arriving long after the work is done. We report rankings monthly so you can watch it build.

faqs.q: How is this different from running ads?
faqs.a: Ads stop the moment you stop paying. SEO earns organic traffic that keeps coming for free once you rank, which is slower to arrive but far more valuable over time.

faqs.q: Who owns the content and site changes?
faqs.a: You do. Every page, optimization, and asset lives on your site and stays yours. We work transparently and hand over full access to everything we touch.

metaDescription: SEO that earns free, compounding organic traffic by ranking your site for the searches your future customers are already typing.

name: Email & CRM Automation
outcome: Every lead followed up, every customer nurtured, without manual effort.
description: We design the email flows and CRM automations that turn a one-time visitor into a repeat customer — welcome sequences, abandoned-cart recovery, re-engagement, all running in the background.
forWho: Businesses generating leads or customers who are currently going cold in a spreadsheet.
problem: Leads come in and then just sit there, going cold in a spreadsheet or inbox. Customers buy once and you never hear from them again because no one has time to follow up by hand. Every missed follow-up is money quietly leaking out.

approach.title: Clean the data
approach.text: We set up your CRM and tidy the data first so automations fire on accurate information. Good flows fail on messy lists.

approach.title: Build the flows
approach.text: We create the lifecycle sequences that do the follow-up for you: welcome, abandoned-cart recovery, and win-back. They run in the background around the clock.

approach.title: Segment and refine
approach.text: We segment and personalize so people get messages that fit where they are. You get reporting on opens, clicks, and revenue so we can improve what works.

faqs.q: What does the setup cover?
faqs.a: It covers CRM setup, data cleanup, the automation workflows, and the email sequences themselves. We agree on the exact scope up front so pricing is clear before any build starts.

faqs.q: How soon will automation pay off?
faqs.a: Once flows are live they work immediately on every new lead, but the compounding value shows over the following months as more contacts move through them. We report opens, clicks, and revenue so you see it.

faqs.q: Do I own the CRM, list, and automations?
faqs.a: Yes. The CRM, your contact data, and every workflow are yours. You keep full access and ownership during our work and after.

metaDescription: Email and CRM automation that follows up every lead and nurtures every customer automatically, with no manual effort.

name: AI Agents & Automation
outcome: Repetitive work handled by software, not another hire.
description: Custom AI agents and workflow automations that handle support triage, data entry, reporting and follow-ups around the clock — built into the tools your team already uses.
forWho: Growing teams drowning in manual work that software could be doing instead.
problem: Your team spends hours every day on work software could handle: copying data between tools, triaging the same support tickets, chasing follow-ups. The obvious fix is another hire, but headcount is slow and expensive. Meanwhile the busywork keeps growing and your best people are stuck doing it.

approach.title: Audit first
approach.text: We map your actual workflows before building anything, so we automate the tasks that waste the most time. No agent gets built for work that doesn't need doing.

approach.title: Built into your stack
approach.text: Agents live inside the tools your team already uses, not some new dashboard nobody opens. The work gets done where it already happens.

approach.title: Human-in-the-loop
approach.text: You decide which actions run automatically and which pause for a person to approve. Nothing consequential happens without a checkpoint you control.

faqs.q: What access do you need to build the agents?
faqs.a: We need access to the tools and workflows we're automating, granted at the permission level the work requires. We scope this with you up front, and you can revoke or narrow it at any time.

faqs.q: How do the safeguards actually work?
faqs.a: Every automation has human-in-the-loop checkpoints where a person reviews or approves before an action runs. You set which steps are fully automatic and which require sign-off, so nothing risky happens unsupervised.

faqs.q: Do we own the agents once they're built?
faqs.a: Yes. You own the systems, the automations and the data they run on. If we stop working together, everything stays with you and keeps running.

metaDescription: AI Agents & Automation from New Machine handles support triage, data entry and follow-ups around the clock, inside the tools you already use.

name: Analytics & BI Dashboards
outcome: One source of truth for what's actually working.
description: We connect your marketing, sales and product data into dashboards built for decisions, not vanity metrics. See what's driving revenue in real time, without exporting five spreadsheets a week.
forWho: Leadership teams making decisions on gut feel because the data lives in ten different tools.
problem: Your numbers live in ten different tools and none of them agree. Every decision means exporting spreadsheets, stitching them together and hoping you got it right. By the time the picture is clear, the moment to act has passed.

approach.title: Connect the sources
approach.text: We pull your marketing, sales and product data into one place so the numbers finally reconcile. No more exporting and merging by hand.

approach.title: Built for decisions
approach.text: Dashboards track revenue and funnel movement, not vanity metrics that look good and mean nothing. Every view answers a question you actually ask.

approach.title: Handed off clean
approach.text: We train your team to read and trust the dashboards before we step back. You run on them daily without needing us in the room.

faqs.q: What data sources can you connect?
faqs.a: We integrate the marketing, sales and product tools you already run on. Tell us your stack and we'll confirm what connects and how before any work starts.

faqs.q: Who owns the dashboards and the data?
faqs.a: You do. The dashboards, the data pipelines and the underlying data are yours. We build them in your environment and hand them off with training.

faqs.q: How is this different from the reporting built into our tools?
faqs.a: Native reports only see one tool's data. We combine every source into one source of truth, so you're comparing the whole funnel instead of guessing across disconnected views.

metaDescription: Analytics & BI dashboards from New Machine unify your marketing, sales and product data into one source of truth built for real decisions.

name: Conversion Optimization
outcome: More revenue from the traffic you're already paying for.
description: We test and refine the pages, flows and offers between a visitor and a sale — structured A/B testing, not guesswork. Small, compounding wins that add up to a materially better conversion rate.
forWho: Businesses with steady traffic who are ready to stop leaking revenue at the last step.
problem: You're paying for traffic that shows up, looks around and leaves without buying. Every visitor who drops off at checkout or a form is money you already spent to acquire. Guessing at fixes and redesigning on a hunch usually makes it worse, not better.

approach.title: Evidence, not opinion
approach.text: We study funnels and heatmaps to find where visitors actually drop off. Changes come from what the data shows, not what anyone thinks looks nicer.

approach.title: Structured testing
approach.text: Every change runs as a hypothesis-driven A/B test and holds until it reaches statistical significance. We keep what wins and drop what doesn't.

approach.title: Compounding wins
approach.text: We stack small, proven improvements across pages, forms and offers. Each one is modest on its own, but they add up to a materially better conversion rate.

faqs.q: How much traffic do we need for this to work?
faqs.a: You need steady, consistent traffic so tests can reach statistical significance in a reasonable time. If volume is low, we'll tell you honestly and focus on the changes most likely to move the needle.

faqs.q: What access to our site and tools do you need?
faqs.a: We need access to your analytics, your testing setup and the pages we're optimizing. We scope this with you up front, and the accounts and data stay yours throughout.

faqs.q: How is this different from a redesign?
faqs.a: A redesign changes everything at once and hopes it helps. We test one change at a time against your real visitors, so you only keep what's proven to lift conversion.

metaDescription: Conversion Optimization from New Machine uses structured A/B testing to turn the traffic you already pay for into more revenue.
